responsibility: This header declares the fixed-buffer command-line argument access API for the mc-boot runtime. It exports the procedures for copying the nth argv entry into a caller-provided character array and for querying argc, defining the stable array-oriented interface that wraps UnixArgs for Modula-2 code.
same_name_distinction: Declaration half of the Args pair: unlike GArgs.cc, it does not access `GUnixArgs` or copy argument data itself, and only exposes the fixed-buffer `Args_GetArg`/`Args_Narg` API for other files to call.
